name: Yellow Curry Corn Soup with Chickpeas, Broccoli & Shiitake [24-09-26] ✴️

ingredients.note: millet, dry weight - toasted and cooked separately on the stove

ingredients.ref: Thai Yellow Curry Paste (The SOS Kitchen)
ingredients.note: dosed high - this jar is 824 mg sodium per 100 g, about a seventh of the Hollyfarms tom yum paste
the citrus lift, without the acid that would grey the broccoli
frozen sweetcorn kernels - as weighed, the anchor the rest is scaled from
leftover chickpeas, already cooked from dry, unsalted
frozen broccoli, all of it in whole at the end for 2-3 min - already blanched, never blended
the only shiitake in the dish - dried, so its guanylate is already formed and its enzymes are long dead
salt at the finish - scaled with the pot to hold 0.23 g per 100 g
